claimsToVerify: Pyramid builders were hired/paid laborers living in nearby towns and eating high-protein diets rather than enslaved workers.
Pyramids did not feature complex mechanical death traps like rolling boulders or spring traps; they used portcullis blocks and shaft dead-ends.
The 'Curse of the Pharaohs' myth was largely amplified and created by 1920s news media covering Howard Carter's King Tut discovery.
Potentially hazardous molds or fungi (like Aspergillus flavus) have been isolated inside unopened ancient tombs.
